item.description:
## New Features
- Support free dragging of the Mechanical HUD across displays with magnetic four-edge snapping and distance-scaled spring bounce. - Add a Follow pointer toggle in HUD Settings so you can keep the HUD pinned to a specific display. - Detect real Dock width and auto-hidden Dock / menu bar states so bottom corners sit flush at the screen edge when clear and glide smoothly out of the way when overlapping. - Add fast, interruptible edge retract and pop-out animations shared by display switching, idle auto-hide, and HUD toggle, with full Reduce Motion support.
## Fixes
- Remove excessive aspect-ratio side margins on HUD corners so the panel sits neatly against screen edges.
